description: Production operations dashboard for one NVIDIA DynamoGraphDeployment at a time. Requires Prometheus, kube-state-metrics with pod labels nvidia.com/dynamo-graph-deployment-name and nvidia.com/dynamo-component-type exposed through kube_pod_labels, node-exporter, and DCGM Exporter pod mapping (exported_namespace/exported_pod). Visual thresholds are starting points, not alert rules; align them with the service SLO and provision alerts separately.

panels.description: Current request throughput for the selected deployment. No value means the request counter or deployment scope telemetry is unavailable.
panels.title: Frontend Request Rate
Output Token Throughput
panels.description: Real-time frontend output token throughput. Uses output_tokens_total, which increments on streamed response chunks rather than waiting for request completion.
Current p95 time to first token at the frontend. The 500 ms warning and 1.5 s critical colors are starting points; replace them with the published service SLO.
panels.title: TTFT p95

panels.description: Current p95 inter-token latency at the frontend. The 50 ms warning and 100 ms critical colors are starting points; replace them with the published service SLO.
panels.title: ITL p95

panels.description: Fraction of frontend requests with status=error (errors/total). green=0, orange>=1%, red>=5%.
panels.title: Frontend Error Ratio

panels.description: Unique selected-deployment pods that are non-running or have an active crash, image-pull, OOM, or container-run failure reason.
panels.title: Dynamo Pods Requiring Attention

panels.description: Requests currently being processed by backend or prefill components, using Dynamo's cross-engine component gauge.
panels.title: Backend Requests In Flight

panels.description: Engine scheduler queue depth for vLLM and SGLang. The pinned TensorRT-LLM metrics contract does not expose an equivalent queue-depth gauge.
panels.title: Backend Queue Depth

panels.description: Requests in frontend preprocess, route, or dispatch stages. This replaces the deprecated queued_requests gauge and represents the full pre-first-token pipeline, not only a scheduler queue.
panels.title: Frontend Pre-First-Token Requests

panels.description: Ready worker, prefill, and decode pods for the selected DynamoGraphDeployment across Deployment, Grove, and LeaderWorkerSet controller paths.
panels.title: Ready Backend Worker Pods

panels.description: Average DCGM GPU utilization attributed to worker pods in the selected deployment. Missing pod mapping remains N/A rather than zero.
panels.title: Deployment GPU Utilization

panels.description: Mean request overlap predicted by the Dynamo KV router for the selected deployment. This is router telemetry, not an engine prefix-cache hit ratio; N/A means no observations or missing telemetry.
panels.title: Router Predicted KV Hit Fraction

panels.description: Frontend p95/p99 TTFT and ITL plus mean end-to-end request duration, split by model. Mixed latency classes intentionally have no shared visual threshold; govern each with its own SLO alert.
panels.title: Frontend Latency: TTFT, ITL, E2E

panels.description: Share of frontend requests failing (status=error), overall and by request_type. Pairs with the Error Rate stat; flat at 0 = healthy.
panels.title: Frontend Error Ratio

panels.description: Frontend request rate broken down by request_type (stream/unary) and status (success/error).
panels.title: Frontend Request Rate

panels.description: Input token rate observed at first token and real-time output token rate observed on streamed response chunks, split by model.
panels.title: Token Throughput: Input and Output

panels.description: Mean input and output sequence length (tokens) per request.
panels.title: Mean Sequence Length

panels.description: Generate request throughput by Dynamo component role. Values such as prefill and backend are serving stages, not engine names.
panels.title: Backend Generate Rate

panels.description: Request and response bytes per second between Dynamo components, grouped by serving role.
panels.title: Frontend-Backend Payload Throughput

panels.description: Cross-engine Dynamo in-flight work plus vLLM/SGLang engine queue depth by pod. No fixed batch-ceiling line is used because capacity is model and deployment specific.
panels.title: Backend Concurrency and Queue by Worker

panels.description: Dynamo's cross-engine per-rank GPU KV cache utilization gauge. max-by rank avoids summing fractional gauges above 100%.
panels.title: GPU KV Cache Usage by Worker / Rank

panels.description: Per-engine p95 scheduler queue latency plus vLLM preemption rate. Engine-native metrics are version dependent; absent series remain absent.
panels.title: Engine Queue Latency and Preemptions

panels.description: vLLM-only per-request phase duration. SGLang TTFT/ITL and TensorRT-LLM TTFT/TPOT are intentionally excluded because they are not equivalent prefill/decode phase metrics.
panels.title: vLLM Prefill vs Decode Duration p95

panels.description: Kubernetes nodes reporting Ready.

targets.expr: sum(max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready",status="true"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Ready Nodes

panels.description: Nodes NOT Ready (red if any).

targets.expr: sum(max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready",status=~"false|unknown"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Not Ready Nodes

panels.description: Selected-deployment pods in Kubernetes Running phase. Use Pods Requiring Attention and Pod Failure Reasons to detect running pods with unhealthy containers.
panels.title: Dynamo Pods Running

panels.description: Counts down Prometheus targets for the selected deployment. A second red value appears when kube-state-metrics does not expose the required DynamoGraphDeployment pod label, which would invalidate dashboard scoping.

targets.expr: absent(kube_pod_labels{label_nvidia_com_dynamo_graph_deployment_name!=""})

panels.title: Observability Health

panels.description: Cluster-wide full-node CPU idle fraction, including host and kernel workload. This is cluster context, not deployment-attributed CPU.
panels.title: Cluster CPU Available

panels.description: Cluster memory headroom (MemAvailable/MemTotal).

targets.expr:
sum(max by (instance) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes))
/
sum(max by (instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes))

panels.title: Cluster Memory Available

panels.description: Rolling 15-minute restart count for containers in the selected deployment. This avoids a cumulative counter that stays tripped forever after one old restart.
panels.title: Dynamo Container Restarts (15m)

panels.description: Active waiting or terminated failure reasons for selected-deployment containers. A value of 1 identifies the pod, container, and reason; healthy periods may show no series.
panels.title: Pod Failure Reasons

panels.description: Per-GPU utilization attributed through DCGM exported_namespace/exported_pod to worker pods in the selected deployment.
panels.title: Deployment GPU Utilization

panels.description: Framebuffer memory used as a fraction of used plus free memory for GPUs attributed to selected-deployment workers.
panels.title: Deployment GPU Memory Utilization

panels.description: DCGM memory-copy utilization for GPUs attributed to selected-deployment workers. This is often a stronger decode saturation signal than SM utilization.
panels.title: Deployment GPU Memory-Bandwidth Utilization
Frontend Tokens per Joule
panels.description: Frontend input-plus-output token rate divided by deployment-attributed GPU power. Because watts are joules per second, the displayed unit is tokens per joule. The result is absent when power telemetry is missing or zero.
Total instantaneous DCGM power draw for GPUs attributed to worker pods in the selected deployment.
panels.title: Deployment GPU Power

panels.description: Trend of the request overlap fraction predicted by the Dynamo KV router. It is defined only while router observations are arriving.
panels.title: Router Predicted KV Hit Fraction

panels.description: Engine-native cache hit ratios. Semantics and availability differ by engine version, so these are diagnostic trends rather than universal health signals.
panels.title: Engine Cache Hit Rate

panels.description: KV-router load by worker: active decode KV blocks on the left axis and active prefill tokens on the right.
panels.title: Router Worker Load

panels.description: Frontend-observed prompt tokens served from cache versus uncached input tokens. If a backend does not report cached-token annotations, the series stays absent rather than being treated as zero reuse.
panels.title: Frontend Cache Token Rate

panels.description: Cluster-wide GPU utilization filtered by GPU host, model, and device variables. This panel is intentionally not scoped to the selected Dynamo deployment.

targets.expr: max by (Hostname, modelName, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{Hostname=~"${gpu_host:regex}",modelName=~"${gpu_model:regex}",gpu=~"${gpu:regex}"})

panels.title: GPU Utilization

panels.description: Cluster-wide framebuffer memory used. DCGM reports MiB, converted to bytes for correct Grafana binary-unit formatting.

targets.expr: max by (Hostname, modelName, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{Hostname=~"${gpu_host:regex}",modelName=~"${gpu_model:regex}",gpu=~"${gpu:regex}"}) * 1024 * 1024

panels.title: GPU Framebuffer Memory Used

panels.description: Per-GPU power draw, cluster-wide.

targets.expr: max by (Hostname, modelName, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE{Hostname=~"${gpu_host:regex}",modelName=~"${gpu_model:regex}",gpu=~"${gpu:regex}"})

panels.title: GPU Power Consumption

panels.description: Per-GPU temperature. Thresholds: orange >=75C, red >=85C.

targets.expr: max by (Hostname, modelName, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP{Hostname=~"${gpu_host:regex}",modelName=~"${gpu_model:regex}",gpu=~"${gpu:regex}"})

panels.title: GPU Temperature

panels.description: Per-GPU SM (streaming-multiprocessor) clock.

targets.expr: max by (Hostname, modelName, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_SM_CLOCK{Hostname=~"${gpu_host:regex}",modelName=~"${gpu_model:regex}",gpu=~"${gpu:regex}"}) * 1000000

panels.title: GPU SM Clock
Cluster Node Capacity and Network Detail

panels.description: Per-node memory available fraction.

targets.expr:
max by (instance) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes)
/
max by (instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes)

panels.title: Node Memory Headroom

panels.description: Per-node root filesystem available fraction.

targets.expr:
min by (instance) (
  max by (instance, device, mountpoint, fstype) (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/",fstype!~"rootfs|tmpfs|overlay"})
  /
  max by (instance, device, mountpoint, fstype) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/",fstype!~"rootfs|tmpfs|overlay"})
)

panels.title: Root Filesystem Headroom

panels.description: Per-node physical NIC throughput (receive shown negative).
panels.title: Node Network Throughput

panels.description: Configured concurrent-sequence ceiling reported for the first registered worker of each model.
panels.title: Max Concurrent Sequences / Worker

panels.description: Configured maximum tokens processed in one engine step, split by model.
panels.title: Max Batched Tokens / Step

panels.description: Maximum configured context length, split by model.
panels.title: Model Context Length

panels.description: KV cache blocks reported by the first registered worker for each model; this is not a deployment-wide sum.
panels.title: KV Blocks / Worker

panels.description: Tokens per KV cache block, split by model.
panels.title: KV Cache Block Size

panels.description: Latest model load duration reported by each selected-deployment worker. Storage path and cache implementation are deployment specific.
panels.title: Worker Model Load Time

title: NVIDIA Dynamo Production Operations
